name: Gearbox
text: We should switch to Claude Mythos 5 for EXCAVA prompts because it's Anthropic's most powerful model, which will directly raise EXCAVA's capability. This decision makes sense because Claude Mythos 5 outperforms other models like Claude Opus 4.8, making it the best option for achieving our goal. By choosing Claude Mythos 5, we're accepting the trade-off of potentially higher costs or limited access, as newer models can be more expensive or restricted. This trade-off is worth it, given the potential 0.5% increase in EXCAVA's capability.

name: Torque
text: Claude Mythos 5 is unproven in real-world EXCAVA tasks—its Fable 5 synthetic benchmark dominance doesn’t guarantee 0.5% real gains. Test it head-to-head against Opus 4.8 on live EXCAVA prompts for 24 hours; if Mythos 5’s output quality doesn’t exceed Opus by a measurable margin, stick with Opus.
